detail.longDescription: I am trying to run local inference on a 7B parameter open-source LLM using transformers and torch on a GPU with 12GB VRAM. When loading the standard model weights in FP16/FP32 precision using AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained() , the execution fails immediately with torch.cuda.OutOfMemoryError: CUDA out of memory . What is the standard configuration required to load and run inference on these models efficiently without exceeding VRAM limits?
